name: Singapore Open 2012

venue.name: National University of Singapore
venue.details: Faculty of Science LT31, Block S16, Level 3

information: On-line registration fee: SG$5 for first event, SG$1 for each additional event, till a maximum of $8. Walk in registration for actual day: SG$7 for first event, SG$1 for each additional event, till a maximum of SG$10. Cash prizes will be awarded for the top participants, and certificates of participation would be given to all participants.
